# Chatham Heating and Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Chatham. Heat pump repair and installation covers diagnosis of operating faults and replacement or installation of compatible heating and cooling equipment.

Email: contact@chathamheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://chathamheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Chatham, Wallaceburg, Tilbury, Blenheim, Ridgetown, Dresden. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
